name: Aethyr Physics Lab records
scope: Lab-only files; no network or product contract
scalar: IEEE 754 binary64; initial physical values rounded to binary32 then promoted

input.bodies: count records of body_f64, dense stable ID order

output.step_ns: steps unsigned 64-bit monotonic durations, engine advance only
output.samples: step 0 and every sample_every steps through steps inclusive; each is u64 step then count body_f64 records

profile.timing: single thread, release, one advance per measured interval; reporting and file I/O excluded
